correctness.rationale: The explicit Pappus LCF graph is identified with the classical incidence presentation by a complete edge-preserving permutation. Every one of the 262,144 possible vertex masks is exhaustively classified. 2,597 nonempty independent faces admit a complete acyclic Forman matching of 1,293 face-cover pairs; all 11,430 ordinary directed face incidences admit a topological sort covering all 2,597 faces. The only critical cells are one zero-cell and ten four-cells. All four-cell attaching maps land in one zero-cell; hence the integral homotopy type is a wedge of ten four-spheres. Independent incidence-based modular boundary calculations for two prime fields confirm the face counts and Betti ranks. Two standalone verifiers ran successfully from their present exact source texts. The finite certificate proves only this fixed-graph statement.

originality.rationale: Searches covered exact Pappus and alternate Levi/incidence, \(9_3\) configuration, complement clique, hypergraph-dual and homology formulations, as well as broad theorems. The full primary texts of Barmak (2010) and Tsukuda (2017) were inspected; their suspension and duality reductions do not calculate the Pappus-specific ten-sphere wedge. The closest exact-graph indexed record addresses the distinct edge matching complex, not graph-vertex independence. Previous claims were checked for implication overlap and no equivalent or stronger covering statement was recovered. Remaining unindexed-literature and inaccessible-public-record risks are acknowledged, not asserted away.

value.rationale: Pappus is the distinguished symmetric cubic Levi graph of the classical Pappus \(9_3\) incidence configuration. Exact integral independence-complex homotopy is a natural canonical invariant for comparative topology of point-line incidence graphs. The eight-dimensional face complex contracts in homotopy to precisely ten four-spheres: neither broad suspension/dual reductions nor face counts alone provide this multiplicity, degree concentration or absence of integral attaching obstructions. Such an exact value is useful as a benchmark for further configuration comparisons; no artificial parameter slice or unsupported general theorem is claimed.
